description: Default capability set for RDAT Copilot's main window. Grants access to the Ollama-related commands and the standard Tauri plugins actually used by the app (shell for opening external URLs, process for app lifecycle). Audit fix #12: removed unused dialog:allow-open, dialog:allow-save, fs:allow-read-text-file, fs:allow-write-text-file permissions — file imports go through the browser's native <input type=file>, not the Tauri fs/dialog plugins, so these were over-permissioned scopes expanding the attack surface for no benefit. The updater plugin is enabled in v0.3.1 with a generated signing keypair (audit fix #13).
